title: Rivet prerender
description: Renders every page of a built Rivet app to HTML files in <outputPath>/client (prerenderBuild of @rivetjs/router/static). Run after the client + server builds.

outputPath.description: Build output folder, relative to the project (holds client/ and server/).

script.description: Run the project's own script instead (relative to the project, e.g. prerender.js).
